title: slow_prep_rank_v1 — Slow prep-menu ranking (registered candidate)

role.description: Agent role; always slow for this stage.

ordered_prep_keys.description: Ordered prep labels from M_large. Schema allows min/max; post-validator enforces length == allowlist_binding.k, distinct, ⊆ allowlist.

rationale.description: Optional form-only rationale; never gated on E.

abstain.description: If true, research adapter treats as non-ok (no shortlist).

allowlist_binding.description: Bind ranking to a frozen M_large identity + fit budget k. Post-validator requires m_large_id and/or m_large_sha256 present and matching the concrete allowlist.

m_large_sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 of ordered M_large label list.

k.description: Fit budget; post-validator requires len(ordered_prep_keys)==k when abstain=false.

form_memory.description: Form-only signals. HARD: no E / delayed utility / test scores. additionalProperties:false rejects E.

non_claims.description: Optional honesty tags, e.g. not_edit_manifest, not_sealed_propose_edit.
